title: fix(plugin-form): a section nav jump in a grouped dialog scrolls only the form
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8AJJJRiYjshMUNgyMZSqBsr)_

Fixes #35092
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：分组表单弹窗里点分组导航时，只滚动表单区自己的滚动容器（`scrollTo`），不再用元素级 `scrollIntoView`；弹窗表单区滚动盒加 `relative`，让复选框、下拉框的隐藏原生 input 被它裁剪、随它滚动。
- 为什么改：点最后一个较短的分组（如 HotCRM 新建线索 → 隐私）时，弹窗盒本身被滚动，标题和导航被滚出弹窗、按钮栏下方留大片空白，且无法滚回，只能关掉弹窗、丢掉已填内容。
- 风险与回滚：只影响分组导航的跳转与弹窗表单区的定位上下文；高亮规则、折叠展开、必填计数未改。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/FormSectionNav.tsx`（新函数 `scrollToHeading` 的滚动距离计算）、`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx`（表单区 `relative`）、`ui/e2e/form-section-nav-dialog-scroll-35092.spec.ts`（缺陷复现腿）。
- 两分钟验证：打开任一带折叠分组的新建弹窗（如 HotCRM 新建线索），点导航最后一项「隐私」：标题、导航、按钮栏不动，表单区滚到底，导航高亮在「隐私」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `FormSectionNav`: a click scrolls the section heading's own scroller (the nearest ancestor whose `overflow-y` is `auto` or `scroll`, found by the file's existing `scrollParentOf`; the window when there is none) with `scrollTo({ top, behavior: 'smooth' })`. The distance is the heading's offset below the scroller's padding edge, less the heading's `scroll-margin-top` (the heading's `scroll-mt-2`) and the scroller's `scroll-padding-top`, which `scrollIntoView` honoured too. The element-level `scrollIntoView` is gone from the jump: it scrolls every scrollable ancestor, the dialog's `overflow: hidden` box included, which is what moved the dialog off its title and navigation when the form's scroller could not bring a short last section to its top.
- `ModalForm`: the form body scroller is `relative`. The absolutely positioned hidden inputs in a form (a Radix checkbox's native stand-in, a Radix select's hidden `select`) took the fixed dialog as their containing block, escaped the scroller's clipping and overflowed the dialog box; now they are clipped by the scroller and scroll with it. Card item 2 (the defence) is included: no regression found. Every other `absolute` in the field widgets sits inside its own `relative` wrapper (icons, counters), and popovers render through portals, so none of them changes containing block.
- Out of scope and untouched, as the card says: the scroll-spy highlight rule (`atBottom` / `jumpedTo`), section folding and the required counts.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/FormSectionNav.test.tsx`: the existing jump assertions now pin `scrollTo` on the form scroller (the ModalForm cases, with the scroller's and dialog box's overflow given inline because the test DOM loads no stylesheet) or on the window (the full-page ObjectForm case), each with the expected distance, and `scrollIntoView` never called. A new top-level describe pins, on the shared fixture now wrapped in an `overflow: hidden` box: the distance from any scroll position, the kept scroll margin, and a short last section asking only the scroller.
- `ui/e2e/form-section-nav-dialog-scroll-35092.spec.ts` (Chromium, CI's E2E project): the real `FormSectionNav` bundled from source, the dialog's class strings read out of `mobile-dialog-content.tsx`, `ModalForm.tsx` and `form.tsx`, real Tailwind. Six sections, the last four folded, the last one two checkboxes with Radix-style hidden inputs. Legs: the defect reproduced (old jump, scroller without `relative`: dialog box overflows and scrolls, title moves); every entry in turn at a desktop and a zoomed-in viewport (dialog `scrollTop` 0, `scrollHeight` equal to `clientHeight`, title, navigation and footer unmoved, highlight on the clicked entry); the last short section alone; and each half of the fix alone holding the dialog box at 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The full-page form (`ObjectForm`, its `sticky top-0` navigation) was not measured in a browser, as on the card. The jump there now scrolls only the nearest scroller instead of every scrollable ancestor; the window case is pinned by the unit test.
- Only Chromium measured, as on the card and as CI's E2E project runs.
- `ui/AGENTS.md` commandment 2 (README and docs page per feature): not applicable to this behaviour fix; no documented surface changes.

The test imports the component by relative path (vitest resolves `@object-ui/plugin-form` to `src`), so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

The six red: the three host cases (ModalForm jump, collapsed unfold, ObjectForm) and the three new #35092 cases.

Same ablation as above, under the e2e: only "either half alone is enough: the new jump without the positioned scroller leaves the dialog box at 0" goes red (5 passed, 1 failed), the expected direction, since the other legs keep the `relative` scroller; restored to the HEAD blob.
